connector.description: Send WhatsApp messages and mark them as read through the WhatsApp Cloud API of Meta.
parameter.whatsapp.phoneNumberId.descrip: The ID of the WhatsApp Business phone number that sends or works with the message.
parameter.whatsapp.to.description: Recipient phone number in international format, digits only, such as 573001234567.
parameter.whatsapp.text.description: The Meta text object, such as {"body": "Hello"}. Optional field: preview_url.
parameter.whatsapp.template.description: The Meta template object: name, language.code and components, as approved in the WhatsApp Business account.
parameter.whatsapp.image.description: The Meta image object: link (https URL of a JPEG or PNG file) and optional caption.
parameter.whatsapp.document.description: The Meta document object: link (https URL), filename and optional caption.
parameter.whatsapp.messageId.description: The WhatsApp message ID (wamid) to mark as read.
changelog.1.0.0.first: First release: text, template, image and document messages, mark as read, and the phone number test.
